item.tib: mkha' 'gro dgongs pa kun 'dus las gsang ba ye shes yon tan gyi bsgrub gzhung skye med rol pa
item.coloph: ces mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes yon tan gyi sgrub pa skye med rol pa chen po 'di ni/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i zhal lung gi dus gcig ma yin par/ yang yang skyongs shing gukye+e Dak+ki ma/ bsnyen bsgrab grogs sbyor ma byas phyin chad/ srog gi 'du shes nges par zhig gis lung ltar/ lnga 'dus kyi khang bu yang*/ bde med rgyu (sgya) ma'i pho brang yang yang 'tshal zhing / rnam shes mgron po kho yang rang yul du bsnyegs pa'i ltas mang du byung ba dang*/ nye bar 'chi med rgyal ba'i bstan pa la/ rgyal ba nyid dang mtshungs pa'i/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa gsang grags rin po che'i gsang don las la sbyor dgos kyis bka' lung gnur (gnad) lji ba phebs pa dang*/ gzhan yang rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag gsang ba sngags kyi bstan pa la gus pa mi dman pa rnams nges tshig bor ba'i phyir/ shar rong rnam dag bkod pa'i zhing du bzhugs pa'i dbyings kyi rgyal yum chen mo rnams kyis (kyi) snang ba'i gzugs brnyen rnams dang mjal zhing / rten 'brel thams cad legs lam du e 'gro yi re ba'i mos la spo yo lung bar bskyod/ der bzhugs kyi zhing skyongs mi'i dbang po bsod nams kyi rgya mtsho chen po mnga' thang gi nor bur spungs pa'i lung grags kyi bstan sbyin dam pa 'di nyid nas/ sgo gsum mi phyed dad pa'i spu longs (long) g.yo ba'i gsungs 'os zab rgya can gnang ba'i nor/ spyal pa'i mkha' 'gro chen mo karma mu tra g.yung drung bde ba'i sman mchog dam pa dang mjal nas thugs nyid brtse ba chen po'i (pos) nges par skyongs ba'i bka' drin la brten/ rnal 'byor sems kyi spos thun reng bu la brda yi zhug le tsha reg gis (gi) yor nub/ nges pa don gyi thig le dri ngad rab tu 'thul pa'i zab gsang snying po 'di ko/ dmu rdo g.yung drung spungs rtse'i byang phyogs las grub rigs kyi sa yi thig le mkha' 'gro 'du gnas ka ke'u seng ge yang rdzong nyi ma rang shar gyi gnas mchog skad snyan bya rigs mang po yis/ gsang sngags kyi don la nges par 'jug pa'i sgra bsnyan (snyan) po lhang lhang sgrogs pa'i gnas su/ gsang bdag kun grol grags pa 'ja' tshon snying po'i (pos) thabs shes rten 'brel gyi 'khor lo rang shugs bsgyur pa'i rtsal las byung ba me 'brug zla tshes la'o//
